name: National General Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, National General Industries Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and selling of steel, handling services of steel products and investing[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Steel Rounds:[2]
Company is producer of hot rolled steel rounds of size range 18 mm to 200 mm diameter. These are used for Bright Bar manufacturers, Earthmoving Industry, Fasteners, Ordinances Factories, Railways, Forgings, Auto components (4 wheelers, 2 wheelers and commercial vehicles) and various heavy engineering industries
b) Steel Squares:[3]
Company manufactures Mild Steel, Carbon Steel & Alloy Steel Squares
c) Steel Flat:[4]
Steel Flat bars are used in manufacture of components for Hand tools like pliers and spanners

pros: Stock is trading at 0.64 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -4.88%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -11.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.08% over last 3 years.
